annotations.title: Chile UF, UTM, dollar, IPC, TPM and more

description: Return one Chilean economic indicator (UF, UTM, observed dollar, euro, IPC, policy rate TPM, IMACEC, copper price, unemployment rate or IVP) for today or a past date, from official Central Bank and INE data. The UF is published in advance: from the 10th of each month, any date up to the 9th of the next month is available (e.g. on 11 November, the UF of 30 November or 9 December). Later dates answer not_published with the expected availability date. Use cl_uf to convert amounts between UF and pesos. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/indicadores via x402.

fecha.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; default today. Only the UF accepts future dates (up to the 9th of next month).

indicador.description: Indicator; default uf. Monthly series (utm, ipc, imacec, tasa_desempleo) are dated on the first day of their month.
